body.title: Player viewport, safe-area, and dynamic viewport height
body.description: First coding task for the site-wide mobile conversion. Branch from latest main. Do not put HTML/CSS/JS into PR #4 (coordination bus). Plan: /cursor/stores/bc-010aff67-9608-48ff-84d1-805258b75a4e/docs/mobile-friendly-conversion-plan.md. Add viewport-fit=cover, safe-area-inset padding on HUD/drawer, 100dvh/100svh with 100vh fallback, avoid 100vw overflow. Do not change notch DSP or HRTF math. Do not start AG-4 PR #3 port yet. Lock index.html in status.md before editing; leave Idle when done. Product PR separate from the bus branch.

dvh/svh with vh fallback; no 375px page-level horizontal scroll
